verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own docs say an agent connected through its MCP server "can read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more) by calling the WorkOS API." That is a direct first-party claim that dashboard actions are available through the API. It is backed by RBAC being configurable "directly in the WorkOS Dashboard or using the API," a published OpenAPI spec, and SDKs covering every HTTP API method. Some settings, such as enabling MFA, are documented only via the dashboard. missing for 10: an exhaustive dashboard-to-API parity mapping, confirmation that environment settings like MFA enablement are API-configurable, independent or hands-on corroboration of full parity.
